prompts.leafFox:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for an illustrated cozy Korean side-scrolling RPG. Reference image is identity/style reference, not layout to copy. Preserve the reference cream leaf-tail fox, lively alternating four-legged trot, its exact colors, face, navy star cape/scarf and gold ornaments. Create EXACTLY 16 isolated full-body action frames in a regular 4 columns by 4 rows square sheet. All figures face RIGHT in the SAME side/three-quarter camera; NO front-facing figures. Each cell has generous clear margin, no touching neighboring cells, no text, labels, borders, ground shadows or scenery. Each age uses constant head/body proportions and constant camera zoom across ALL its poses.
Row 1: BABY four successive locomotion cycle poses: left forepaw forward/right hindpaw forward contact; passing with opposite paws lifted; opposite contact with right forepaw forward/left hindpaw forward; opposite passing. Make the leg articulation visibly different, with convincing planted and lifted feet. Torso center remains in the same cell position.
Row 2: SAME BABY, col1 standing rest eyes open, col2 SAME standing rest eyes gently closed blinking, col3 jumping with ALL feet tucked below body, col4 cheerful greeting one forepaw lifted and smiling.
Row 3: ADULT four successive locomotion frames with the same alternating contact/passing arrangement as row1; same species and clothing, more mature proportions.
Row 4: SAME ADULT, standing rest eyes open; SAME rest blinking; airborne leap feet tucked; happy greeting one forepaw raised.
All grounded figures have their feet on an identical floor baseline within their cell. Consistent scale within age. Entire ears and tails fit. Hand-painted clean anime storybook outlines, softly shaded polished game sprites matching reference. True alpha transparency. Exactly 4x4 cells, 16 poses, no eggs.
